import XCTest

final class TapFeedsTests: XCTestCase {
    func testOpenFeedsTab() throws {
        let springboard = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "com.apple.springboard")
        let cancel = springboard.buttons["Cancel"]
        if cancel.waitForExistence(timeout: 3) { cancel.tap() }

        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "xyz.blueskyweb.app")
        app.activate()
        let predicate = NSPredicate(format: "label BEGINSWITH 'Feeds'")
        let feeds = app.descendants(matching: .any).matching(predicate).firstMatch
        if !feeds.waitForExistence(timeout: 15) {
            print(app.debugDescription)
            XCTFail("Feeds tab not found")
            return
        }
        feeds.tap()
        sleep(2)
        let shot = XCTAttachment(screenshot: XCUIScreen.main.screenshot())
        shot.lifetime = .keepAlways
        add(shot)
    }
}
EOF
